import narwhals as nw
import pandas as pd

# Create sample data
data = {
    'id': [1, 2, 3],
    'jan': [100, 200, 300],
    'feb': [150, 250, 350],
    'mar': [200, 300, 400]
}
df_pd = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Convert to narwhals DataFrame
df = nw.from_native(df_pd)

# Reshape from wide to long format
result = df.unpivot(
    on=['jan', 'feb', 'mar'],
    index=['id'],
    variable_name='month',
    value_name='sales'
)

# Display result
print(result.to_native())
